sloka: विशाल वक्षास् ताम्र अक्षो नील कुन्चित मूर्धजः ।एषो अस्य लक्ष्मणो नाम भ्राता प्राण समः प्रियः ॥६-२८-२३॥।।
transliteration: viśāla vakṣās tāmra akṣo nīla kuncita mūrdhajaḥ ।eṣo asya lakṣmaṇo nāma bhrātā prāṇa samaḥ priyaḥ ॥6-28-23॥।।

translations.english: "To his right is his brother known as Lakshmana whose body radiates like gold, he has broad chest, red eyes, dark curly hair. He is as dear as his life to Rama. He is skilled in moral science and warfare. He is the foremost and the best among wielders of weapons."
translations.hindi: आर जिनकी खी सीता को तुम जनस्थान से हर लाए हो हे राजन्‌! वे ही श्रीरामचन्द्र तुमसे लड़ने के लिए यहाँ आए हैं
